The package builds from a pinned, verifiable upstream source, uses no `git clone` or mutable references, and does not skip checksums. All actions are transparent and aligned with the declared purpose of packaging a Rust-based audio application with CLAP/VST3 plugin support. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, remote code execution, or supply-chain tampering.
